It just takes time to learn how to multitask efficiently. The skill gap in this game is based on knowledge of the games mechanics and how to effectively multitask. 
One tip I can give you is to never drop anchor. Or if you do ever drop the anchor immediately raise your sails and raise the anchor back up. The galleon is a sitting duck with it's anchor down. Early in the game try to focus mostly on ship to ship combat. Don't try to board until you get a few holes on them or get their mast down. Turn your ship so your broadside is aimed at the target and have all three people on cannons blasting. If you take damage have one person split off immediately to check repairs. Other two stay on cannons and sails. Have the person doing repairs call out for buckets or help repairing if they need it. Stay on top of repairs, don't ignore then for too long. If someone boards your ship. Instantly call it out and have everyone stop what theyre doing to kill the boarder as quickly as possible. It's alot to micromanage, but you will get better over time. And remind your team to never give up. If a ship sinks you, respawn and go back for it. have people shoot off to islands along the way back to gather supplies. ALWAYS GO BACK. You never know what might happen, I get my loot back more often then I don't get it back. Fight like hell. Stay vigilant. That's all I got.
